0x000806.en: 「At my level now...@　is this as far as I go...!」

0x000877.en: 「Guh!@ So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008FF.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x000979.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000B29.en: 「Tch! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000B64.en: 「Losing it in a place like this...!@　This isn't funny...」

0x000BB8.en: 「Blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000CA2.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D09.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DB5.en: 「No good, took too much damage... I'm retreating!」

0x000E02.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E40.en: 「Kyah! I leave the rest to you!」

0x000E87.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F32.en: 「Ngh... to think I'd become a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x00102A.en: 「Aw shoot, they went and got me!」

0x0010DB.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001122.en: 「I'm sorry, I leave the rest to you.」

0x001157.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as my power goes...!」

0x001243.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x001291.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x00134C.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x00137B.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013B9.en: 「Well, well... so this is the end.」

0x0013E8.en: 「I can't go on. Allow me to take my leave.」

0x001473.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x0015D9.en: 「I'm bailing out...@ ngh...! Not very graceful...」

0x00192B.en: Federation Far East Army, Izu Base

0x0019A3.en: 「Yeah...@ though we weren't actually there when it happened...」

0x0019FF.en: 「You didn't hear about it from Lieutenant Hugo?」

0x001A45.en: 「I knew he'd been a member of the Cry Wolves,@ but about that... nothing at all...」

0x001AD8.en: 「We're forbidden from speaking about that matter@ to outsiders...」

0x001B37.en: 「I thought maybe Lieutenant Aqua,@ being a member of the Zentr Project,@ might know something...」

0x001C04.en: 「Lieutenant Aqua, a message for you.@ The seventh TE Absorber prototype's@ arrival will be delayed about two hours...」

0x001C8E.en: 「...Thanks, Latooni.@ I'll go let Hugo know.」

0x001D18.en: 「Hugo, there's something I want to talk about...」

0x001D93.en: 「Sorry, but... could you get me some water?」

0x001DCD.en: 「Huh!? I'm your partner, not your maid, you know!」

0x001E54.en: 「Wh-what's with that serious face? Are you actually feeling sick?」

0x001EA7.en: 「Honestly, you're hopeless.@ Water, right? Just water.」

0x001F29.en: (...The numbness in my legs...@ Is the medicine wearing off faster now...?)

0x001F94.en: (Or was it the drug@ they gave me before I came here...?)

0x002038.en: 「No... I was going to take some medicine.」

0x00207C.en: 「...Just cold medicine.@ So... what did you want to talk about?」

0x0020C6.en: 「Right, there's something I wanted to ask you...@ It's... hard to bring up, but...」

0x00213D.en: 「Your old unit... the Cry Wolves,@ it doesn't exist anymore, does it...」

0x0021A8.en: 「I heard it was from fighting a monster called the Jetzt.@ And that... it had something to do with@ the Zentr Project.」

0x00227B.en: 「What of it... I was never told the Project@ had a past like that, and why you'd even...」

0x00230A.en: 「Why I'd meekly serve the people who brought about@　my own unit's destruction... is that it?」

0x0023AF.en: 「I got involved with the Zentr Project@ because those were my orders.」

0x002423.en: 「That's true for me too, but...@ there's still so much we don't understand about the Medius Locus matter...@ Just what were they making the Jetzt for anyway...?」

0x0024D4.en: 「The rank and file are never told everything.@ Don't go prying more than you need to. Just carry out@ the duties you're given.」

0x002582.en: 「A-and what about you? With Doctor Zapad...」

0x0025CB.en: 「I told you not to pry. It's for your own good.」

0x00260B.en: 「Lieutenant Hugo, Lieutenant Aqua,@ report to Briefing Room 12.」

0x00269B.en: 「Another pair of transfers has come up from Antarctica.@ We're having everyone get acquainted.」

0x002744.en: 「Everyone's here.@ Effective today, I'm introducing the test pilots@ our squad has taken on.」

0x0027D1.en: 「...I'm Joshua Radcliff.@ Please call me Josh.」

0x002830.en: 「Cliana Rimskaya... call me Lim.@ I came along to accompany my brother.」

0x00290A.en: (They're both younger than me...@ I never expected the new members to be younger...)

0x00297E.en: 「Josh and Lim aren't military. They're civilians...@ Re-Technologists.」

0x0029E9.en: 「Excuse me, Major Kai.@ My old man... my father was one, that's all.@ I'm not a Re-Tech myself.」

0x002AC9.en: 「Researchers obsessed with 'lost technology.'@ They study the ruins found in Antarctica.」

0x002BA8.en: 「This is the first I've heard of it.」

0x002BC7.en: 「If it had been the LTR Agency that found them,@ it'd have been made public long ago, but...」

0x002C47.en: 「My old man's crowd only cared about@ keeping such prime research material to themselves.」

0x002CA9.en: 「First, they'd study it till satisfied.@ In a sense, Re-Techs may be pure researchers.@ But that's what left the study deadlocked.」

0x002D7E.en: 「In the end, my old man's group ran short on funds@ and had to rely on people scheming to@ militarize the ruins' over-technology.」

0x002E54.en: 「Over-technology...@ Could there be <EOT> in the Antarctic ruins?」

0x002EBE.en: 「They say there's no connection to the <Aerogaters>@ or <Inspectors>. In the end, no one still knows@ who built those ruins, or why.」

0x002FC2.en: 「The Aile Chevalier...@ Even the name of its system, Race Arcana,@ means mystery, or the unknown.」

0x00306D.en: 「Anyway, once they knew it could stand in for a generator,@ Cliff figured they'd install it and see what happened...」

0x00311B.en: 「He's a Re-Tech, my father's assistant.@ That's what he said.」

0x003177.en: 「...In other words, you were made a guinea pig.」

0x0031C0.en: 「Hugo, that's a terrible way to put it...!」

0x0031FA.en: 「I'm not exactly thrilled either, finding out I was made@ a test subject for a system that won't run@ unless someone's in it.」

0x0032A8.en: 「But even so, there was a reason I had to@ pilot the Aile Chevalier.」

0x00334D.en: 「...A lot happened out on that frontier too.@ Not just the <Antarctic Incident>, but <Einst> attacks as well.」

0x0033D8.en: 「If the Federation can't handle those monsters,@ then we've no choice but to use mobile weapons or@ whatever it takes to protect ourselves.」

0x00347D.en: (A means to survive... is that it?)

0x0034B7.en: (...And unless we unravel the true nature of the Sympatia@ loaded in the Aile Chevalier too, Lim will...)

0x00354F.en: 「In any case, it's unusual, but these are orders@ from Commander Kenneth... you'll be helping@ gather data on the Aile Chevalier as well.」

0x00360F.en: 「There's also the Ki-Machine that hit the Tesla@ Institute, and Medius Locus, the group after the@ new machine. Don't let your guard down.」

0x00370C.en: 「Oh, so Josh just lets it slide.@ Most people would call it out.」

0x00377D.en: (...It's just how she talks, that's all...)

0x0037AE.en: 「Note that the Re-Techs and Antarctic ruins are classified.@ Do not speak of them to outsiders.」

0x003816.en: 「Now then, today we head to the Mizudori Island@ training grounds for a mock battle. Attend the@ loading of your machines onto the transport.」

0x0038EC.en: 「Ah, I know it takes time to adjust that thing.@ We'll depart once your setup is finished.」

0x0039A3.en: 「...Then, sorry, but we're counting on you.@ The sponsors are pushing us to produce combat data@ against <PT>s and <special machines>.」

0x003A5E.en: 「...So that's why we got picked as opponents.@ How casual of you.」

0x003AB7.en: 「Hugo, we're in the same position.@ We're gathering data on the Garmraid too...」

0x003B31.en: 「Lieutenant Hugo Medio... was it?@ From a professional's view, I understand it's not much fun.」

0x003BB7.en: 「I'm just as out of my element as you are.」

0x003BE8.en: 「So you've got your own circumstances too.」

0x003C1C.en: 「Yeah, we've got to gather data on a new machine too.@ Civilian or not, I won't hold back.」

0x003CA2.en: (Hugo's on edge...?@ Because the Medius Locus business is bothering him?@ Or is it...)

0x003D32.en: 「So that's the seventh TE Absorber prototype,@ the Garmraid...」

0x003D8B.en: 「Couldn't tell the shape while it was loaded, but...@ what a rugged-looking super robot.@ Lieutenant Ryusei would love it.」

0x003E86.en: 「No, it's okay...@ I believe Ryusei, Mai, Lieutenant Kyosuke,@ and everyone in the Steel Dragon Squadron are safe.」

0x003F22.en: 「So I'm taking photos of the Garmraid@ and the Aile Chevalier...」

0x003F8A.en: 「To show Lieutenant Ryusei when he comes back?」

0x003FDA.en: 「Race Alcana,@　Sympathia, FCS, check.@　...Good. Feeling solid.」

0x004058.en: 「Aqua, your output's unstable.@　Wavering around the middle of the yellow zone@　just won't cut it.」

0x0040E5.en: 「It's got more power than the Cerberus, and@　a wider swing, so I can't tune it right...!」

0x004165.en: 「I'm not making excuses that easy for@　Mitarl to see through. Show me you can do it.」

0x0041F2.en: 「Joshua's machine...@　against a special unit, the odds aren't great.」

0x00424E.en: 「The point is gathering data under all@　kinds of conditions. This isn't about winning.」

0x0042B9.en: 「All right, you two, round one. Begin!」

0x004331.en: （A special unit...!@　But I'm not making a losing bet...@　I'll take it down clean, right here!）

0x0043B5.en: 「Aile Chevalier...@　We can do this, you and me!」

0x004477.en: （My hands and feet are going numb...!@　No, it's too soon for that.）

0x004501.en: （So the drug's effect@　is wearing off faster now...!?）

0x004554.en: （This is no joke,@　if my limbs seize up mid-battle...!）

0x004616.en: 「Round one, situation over.@　Joshua takes the first point.」

0x00468B.en: 「Hey, what's the matter?@　You were skirting the yellow zone, but the output was...」

0x004715.en: （The Garmraid was moving strangely.@　But it wasn't machine trouble...）

0x0047D3.en: 「Matches the data from the Tesla Institute.@　Demons... Yokijin.」

0x0048ED.en: 「I'll nurse it along... for a short fight, anyway.」

0x00492D.en: 「Are you really okay?@　Aren't you feeling sick?」

0x0049D3.en: 「...No one told me not to gather combat data.@　I'm in.」

0x004A51.en: 「I can't just leave someone who's@　not at full strength out here.」

0x004AA4.en: 「Fine... but don't push it.@　All units, commence attack!」

0x004C3E.en: 「Yokijin... I'll grab what data I can while I'm here.」

0x004C84.en: 「Not like the Einst. So this is a Yokijin...!」

0x004CC7.en: 「...Major Kai, I've sent the Yokijin@　data to the Tesla Institute.」

0x004D26.en: 「Good. I brought up the Yokijin before the mock battle,@　but I thought it unlikely... yet here they really are.」

0x004DBE.en: 「Unlike the incident at the Tesla Institute,@　no new <Chokijin> appeared, but...@　what could the enemy be after?」

0x004E59.en: 「I don't know, but their appearance@　may be no coincidence.」

0x004EF0.en: 「...Hugo, Joshua,@　do you two have any idea?」

0x004F5C.en: 「...You're saying we newcomers are the cause?」

0x004FA5.en: 「It's only a possibility. The Aile Chevalier uses@　unknown technology... I wondered if there might be@　some connection there.」

0x005077.en: 「If so, wouldn't they show up@　at the South Pole first?」

0x0050C7.en: 「True enough...@　To be safe, send the Yokijin data to Re-Tech too@　and have them look into it.」

0x005148.en: 「I'll ask, but I think it's pointless.@　They're only interested in ruins.」

0x0051C5.en: 「For our part,@　we'd welcome any clue we can get.」

0x00528B.en: 「That mock battle...@　you weren't handicapping yourself, were you?」

0x0052E7.en: 「No, I said I wouldn't hold back.」

0x00531E.en: 「...I see. It just didn't look like@　machine trouble to me.」

0x005377.en: （Hmph... sharp instincts, that one.@　And his skills are the real deal.）

0x0053D9.en: 「You didn't go easy on him, did you, Hugo?@　Because there wasn't enough fitting time?」

0x00545F.en: 「Then it really is... my fault, isn't it.」

0x005496.en: 「...That's not it. The cause is... me.」

0x0054CD.en: （I have to shorten the interval between doses...@　It'll run out faster, but that beats@　the effect fading mid-battle.）

0x0055AA.en: 「No, never mind. More importantly,@　there's something I want to ask you two.@　Is that all right?」

0x00564A.en: 「This Izu base is the Steel Dragon Squadron's home port, right?@ But I don't see the Hagane or Hiryu Kai around.@ Are they out on a mission somewhere?」

0x0056FB.en: 「Actually... the Steel Dragon Squadron went missing@　during an exercise.」

0x005788.en: 「Yes... It wasn't a wreck or anything.@　They just vanished out at sea.」

0x0057DE.en: 「And Lieutenant Kyosuke Nanbu and Second Lieutenant@　Ryusei Date went missing at the Tesla Institute,@　machines and all...」

0x00587A.en: 「A friend in Asakusa, and a princess we know,@　they disappeared too...」

0x005913.en: 「The cause is under investigation,@　but we've got no solid leads.」

0x005978.en: 「The friends of ours who vanished@　have come through fierce battles before, so...@　I really believe they're all right.」

0x005A29.en: （The Yokijin aren't the only strange thing going on...）

0x005ABF.en: 「Bro, I hear there was a battle?」

0x005AF3.en: 「...Liana, don't just switch out of nowhere.」

0x005B30.en: 「Sorry, sorry.@　Staying quiet the whole time is rough.」

0x005B7D.en: 「Sorry to make you feel so cramped.」

0x005BB1.en: 「No choice, I guess.@ If people found out about me and Chris,@ they'd be shocked.」

0x005C20.en: 「Earlier, when I went to the mess hall...@　I slipped and talked as Liana,@　and a soldier gave me a weird look.」

0x005D06.en: 「I know, bro.@　But how long do we keep it secret?」

0x005D62.en: 「For a while yet.@　I still don't have a good read on@　what kind of people the instructor corps are.」

0x005DE3.en: 「They don't seem like bad people, though...」

0x005E27.en: 「Hey, big brother...@　Father and the others must be worried by now, huh.」

0x005E83.en: 「Because I took you away without a word?」

0x005EB7.en: 「No word from the South Pole.@　They must know I'm the one who took you out.」

0x005F2E.en: 「Though what my old man cares about@　might not be you two, but the Sympathia.」

0x005FDA.en: 「Either way, I couldn't leave you two@　in a place like that.」

0x006036.en: 「Only my old man and I need to touch the Sympathia.@　I'll never let them use you as test subjects again...!」
